boundaries: Recoverable-contained elements are not ore or concentrate tonnes.
Separated oxide equivalents are stoichiometric reference mass only; oxygen/reagents are outside the tracked-element conservation ledger.
Finished magnets only serve the selected illustrative composition and assumed generic customer; no cross-grade fungibility or property prediction.
A single finite paid inventory order enters the material ledger at the shared decision month and arrives after a positive procurement lead; no automatic exogenous replenishment.
All interventions use the same abstract budget and decision month; fixed-total resource geography diversification does not expand resource capacity.
Finite initial steady-state pipeline and working stocks are explicit in the initial element ledger; the same-policy no-shock counterfactual isolates scenario shock increments from all-cause backlog.

Scenario credits cover intervention commitments only; ordinary input procurement, operation/energy, financing and full commodity-price accounting are not priced. New capacity bundles use the nominal demand/yield reference, separate from existing stage-capacity factors.
